title: Formalize the explicit extraction of cos(nθ) and sin(nθ) formulas by comparing real and imaginary parts

problemStatement.plain: The polynomials P_n = T_n (Chebyshev first kind) and Q_n = U_n (Chebyshev second kind) satisfy cos(nθ) = T_n(cos θ) and sin((n+1)θ) = U_n(cos θ)·sin θ for all integers n.
whyMatters: This is the abstract content of De Moivre's theorem: the real and imaginary parts of (cos θ + i sin θ)^n are polynomials in cos θ and sin θ.
The Chebyshev polynomials T_n and U_n arise naturally from this extraction and have wide applications in approximation theory and numerical analysis.

proven: cos(nθ) = T_n(cos θ) for all n ∈ ℤ [Mathlib: T_real_cos]
sin((n+1)θ) = U_n(cos θ)·sin θ for all n ∈ ℤ [Mathlib: U_real_cos]
Double through quintuple angle formulas for cos and sin
knownResults.goal: ACHIEVED: Full polynomial extraction formalized with 0 sorries.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved explicit polynomial extraction of cos(nθ) and sin(nθ) in DeMoivreOQ01.lean (0 sorries, 19 theorems). Key results: cos_nsmul_chebyshev_T, sin_nsmul_chebyshev_U, existence theorems, explicit T_3 through T_5 and U_3, U_4, double through quintuple angle formulas, and general cosine recurrence.
builtItems: cos_two_mul_eq through sin_five_mul_eq (DeMoivreOQ01.lean:128-201): double to quintuple angle formulas
cos_nsmul_rec (DeMoivreOQ01.lean:212): general cosine recurrence for all integer n
insights: Mathlib's T_real_cos and U_real_cos (Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Chebyshev) directly prove the main extraction theorems
Chebyshev polynomials are ℤ-indexed in Mathlib (not just ℕ), giving formulas for negative multiples too
CRITICAL: ↑(n+1) vs (↑n + 1) are propositionally but NOT definitionally equal in Lean 4 — statement must use ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * θ to match Mathlib's U_real_cos elaboration
T_add_two (R := ℝ) requires explicit ring annotation for Lean to synthesize CommRing ℝ instance
simp only [show (1+2:ℤ)=3 from by decide] pattern needed to reduce integer arithmetic in Chebyshev indices
Direct proofs via Real.cos_add/Real.sin_add are cleaner than rewriting through Chebyshev for specific n values
nextSteps: Could formalize the binomial expansion formula for T_n to explicitly show the alternating sign structure
Could prove the Chebyshev-De Moivre connection is the basis for angle trisection impossibility
